description: Source code for Kubernetes admission webhook namespace matcher, including namespace retrieval, validation, label fetching, and namespace selector matching logic.

classes.name: NamespaceSelectorProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing a parsed namespace selector for webhook matching.

classes.name: Matcher
classes.description: Struct that contains logic to match namespaces against a selector, including namespace retrieval and validation.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves a namespace by name, directly from cache or storage if not found in cache.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates that the Matcher has necessary components (NamespaceLister and Client).

methods.name: GetNamespaceLabels
methods.description: Fetches labels of a namespace based on admission attributes, handling creation, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: MatchNamespaceSelector
methods.description: Determines if a request matches the namespace selector, considering namespace labels and request context.
